errors.evidence: Description states that the blue bar for Картофи reaches approximately 170,000 tons, but the figure shows it reaches around 16,000 tons.
Description claims that the orange bar for Картофи is around 120,000 tons, while the figure shows it is around 14,000 tons.
Description mentions Дини values being around 80,000 tons, but the figure shows they are closer to 6,000 tons.
Description states Домати shows values of approximately 70,000 tons for 2022, while the figure shows it is around 10,000 tons.
Description claims Пипер (вкл. лют) and Главесто зеле have bars between 40,000 and 47,000 tons, but they are closer to 4,000 - 5,000 tons in the figure.
Description specifies Лук кромид – зрял shows values around 27,000 and 39,000 tons, whereas the figure shows approximately 3,000 tons and 5,000 tons respectively.
Description states Пъпеши reach approximately 21,000 tons for 2022, while the figure shows it is around 2,000 tons.
Description indicates final categories' values reach between 5,000 and 10,000 tons, but they actually reach values below 2,000 tons in the figure.
The description omits to mention the scale of the vertical axis, which ranges from 0 to 200,000 tons in increments of 20,000.
The description fails to mention that the bars for some vegetables are significantly lower than the stated figures.
